svg.title: SOLAS (2024 – 2025)
svg.desc: SOLAS, 2024 to 2025: VR serious game about the solar system, Unity and C#, tested on Meta Quest 3.
svg.text: virtual reality serious game · project lead, team of 4 · ENSIM
Teaches the solar system to young players: a planet-to-planet journey with landings on the
Moon, Mars and Earth, text and voice-over at each stop.
Complete game tested on Meta Quest 3; early version shown at ENSIM open days.
